probes.name: Box_fraction_limit
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim count As Long, log As String
Dim obj As New Box
For obj.apple = 1 To 1.5
count = count+1
log = log & CStr(obj.apple) & ";"
If count >= 8 Then Exit For
Next
Probe = log & "|" & CStr(obj.apple)
End Function
